# Psalm 110 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Of-David. A-psalm. Utterance-of YHWH to-my-lord: 'Sit at-my-right-hand, until I-make your-enemies a-footstool for-your-feet.'

**2** The-rod-of your-strength will-send YHWH from-Zion; rule in-midst-of your-enemies.

**3** Your-people freewill-offerings in-day-of your-power; in-splendors-of holiness from-womb-of the-dawn, to-you the-dew-of your-youth.

**4** Has-sworn YHWH and-not will-he-relent: 'You a-priest to-forever according-to-order-of Melchizedek.'

**5** The-Lord at-your-right-hand has-shattered in-day-of his-anger kings.

**6** He-will-judge among-the-nations full-of corpses; he-has-shattered the-head over the-wide earth.

**7** From-the-brook on-the-way he-will-drink; therefore he-will-lift-up the-head.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **110:1**: Ne'um YHWH la'adoni — 'Utterance-of YHWH to-my-lord' — the most-cited OT verse in the NT (Matt 22:44, Acts 2:34, Heb 1:13). David's lord is greater than David.

- **110:4**: Melchizedek — priest-king of Salem (Gen 14:18). The combining of priestly and royal roles in one figure is unique and foundational for Hebrews 5-7.

— EMET
